item.title: Move Data Not Drama: Simplifying your Workflow with Meltano
item.description: Meltano is a powerful open-source data movement tool that has revolutionized the way organizations handle their data pipelines at scale. Before the Analytics Development Lifecycle was even a thing, Meltano was working to bring software engineering best practices to data teams. This session will explore how Meltano addresses common data management challenges with a single, unified, and customizable platform.
